title: Sets, operations, and closure
subject: Mathematics
summary: Choose your objects, define an operation, and check whether its results stay inside the set.

title: Associativity, identity, and inverses
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to regroup operations, identify an element that does nothing, and find an inverse within the chosen set.

title: Groups — putting the properties together
subject: Mathematics
summary: Combine the group properties, explore square rotations, and prove cancellation.

title: Subgroups — groups inside groups
subject: Mathematics
summary: Check identity, closure, and inverses inside a subset, inherit associativity, and prove the subgroup test.

title: Generated subgroups and cyclic groups
subject: Mathematics
summary: Build a subgroup from one element, distinguish finite and infinite cyclic groups, and find an element's order.

title: Cosets — moving a subgroup through a group
subject: Mathematics
summary: Use a subgroup to sort its parent group into cosets, starting with the general definition and then integer remainders.

title: Lagrange’s theorem — counting with cosets
subject: Mathematics
summary: Prove that a finite subgroup's size divides its group's size, then use the theorem to constrain element orders.
